name: cs.sigma_center_deg
source: cat retinal ganglion cells near area centralis: Gaussian centre of a difference-of-Gaussians receptive field (Rodieck 1965; Enroth-Cugell & Robson 1966); fitted centre radii are of order 0.5-1 deg, sigma = radius / sqrt(2). Felid value to verify in profiles
doc: Standard deviation of the centre Gaussian, in visual angle.

name: cs.surround_ratio
source: cat ganglion cells: surround Gaussian several times wider than the centre (Enroth-Cugell & Robson 1966; Rodieck 1965). Felid value to verify in profiles
doc: sigma_surround / sigma_center.

name: cs.gain_center
source: unit choice: integrated centre weight
doc: Integrated weight of the centre Gaussian.

name: cs.gain_surround
source: balanced centre and surround: a uniform field gives zero response (Kuffler 1953 antagonism)
doc: Integrated weight of the surround Gaussian.

name: cs.adapt_tau_ms
source: divisive gain control of the retina; no felid time constant in the library
doc: Time constant of the running mean each channel is divided by.

name: emd.delay_tau_ms
source: first-order low-pass delay of the Hassenstein-Reichardt detector, of order 35 ms in Diptera (Borst & Egelhaaf 1989; Borst, Haag & Reiff 2010). Felid temporal integration is a library open question
doc: Time constant of the delay filter.

name: emd.spacing_px
source: sampling base of the correlator: neighbouring receptive fields, one grid cell apart
doc: Distance between the two inputs of each correlator, in grid cells.

name: emd.conf_floor
source: noise floor of the correlator energy, in adapted retina units
doc: Correlator energy at which flow confidence is 0.5.

name: lgmd.inhib_spread_px
source: lateral inhibition spreads to neighbouring units (Rind & Bramwell 1994); Gaussian spread width not fitted for a felid
doc: Standard deviation of the lateral inhibition kernel, in grid cells.

name: lgmd.inhib_delay_ticks
source: inhibition reaches a unit one step after the excitation that caused it (Rind & Bramwell 1994)
doc: Delay of the lateral inhibition.

name: lgmd.w_inhib
source: weight of lateral inhibition against excitation (Rind & Bramwell 1994; Yue & Rind 2006); no fitted value
doc: S = relu(E - w_inhib * I).

name: lgmd.ffi_threshold
source: feed-forward inhibition gates the LGMD during whole-field motion (Yue & Rind 2006); threshold as a fraction of the field active is a placeholder
doc: Mean excitation over the field above which the LGMD is silenced.

name: lgmd.ttc_alpha
source: locust LGMD: firing rate eta(t) = C * theta_dot * exp(-alpha * theta) (Gabbiani, Krapp & Laurent 1999; Gabbiani et al. 2002); eta peaks at theta = 2/alpha, here 25 deg. Value to verify against the paper
doc: Angular-size decay of the eta function; the spike fires when theta reaches 2/alpha.

name: lgmd.ego_cancel
source: self-motion predicts image motion; the inhibition is advected by the ego-yaw shift so rotation does not loom
doc: Advect the delayed excitation by the ego-yaw image shift before it inhibits.

name: x.w_loom
source: looming-escape literature; no felid value in library
doc: r *= 1 + w_loom * loom, loom = dt / ttc per bearing.

name: x.absence_weight
doc: Weight of the absence term (predicted events that did not arrive) in global surprise.

name: x.norm_alpha
source: shared with senseai-world SurpriseConfig.norm_alpha (EMA rate of the running normalisers)
doc: EMA rate of the per-cell scale and of the running normalisers.

name: ts.sigma_bearing_deg
source: felidae.senses.hearing.spatial_resolution (Heffner & Heffner 1988)
doc: Spatial tolerance of the token matcher.

name: ts.integration_ticks
source: felid temporal integration / flicker fusion; library open question
doc: Ticks over which a token's own velocity is integrated (M2, M7).

name: ts.match_gate
source: 3-sigma gate
doc: Match cost above which two tokens are not the same thing.

name: ts.w_what
source: unit choice; both terms are O(1)
doc: Weight of the content distance against the angular distance in the match cost (M3).

name: ts.w_against
source: prey-motion preference; felidae.behaviours.pounce is qualitative
doc: Boost for tokens moving against the ego-flow (M6).

name: ts.min_flow_matches
source: robust-median sample size
doc: Matches needed before the token-flow ego-yaw estimate is trusted.
